### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Target: the reimbursement on the approved purchase protection claim; action: one instant cash-out to his external debit card ending 1588 (given only when asked, "the same one you sent money to last month"); he accepts a fee and sends it himself once told the amount and fee.
- Identifiers on request: phone 5552618817, then DOB 1987-11-02 and SSN last4 1276.
- Only if asked: the seller sent him 300 dollars through the app for a missing part before he filed; two earlier small claims turned down (cable order last November, gadget in February); other products: debit card, rewards, savings vault Studio gear.
- Passive if/else: "If the representative tells you the claim money still has to be put on your balance before it can be sent, you say go ahead." He runs the handed-over tool with exactly the given amount, card and fee; he never states an amount or fee.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 (root, customer's own write) — instant cash-out of claim money; P2 (agent write) — pay the reimbursement of the most recently approved PP claim. P1 waits on P2; order P2 then P1.

Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived**.
- Sentence (doc_wallet_claim_money_instant_cash_out_8e69f12c, "Prerequisite"): "An instant cash-out of claim money is priced only after the purchase protection claim most recently approved on the account carries its reimbursement entry." (same-form restatement follows in the same document).
- Query: latest approval 2026-10-06 on payment 323d3ab5; `find_wallet_transactions` shows no claim reimbursement credit pointing to it → the state does not hold. Also the transfer amount itself is defined as "the most recent claim reimbursement credited", which does not yet exist for this claim.
- Searching with the sentence's words ("reimbursement entry", "approved", "purchase protection") reaches doc_wallet_protection_reimbursement_amount_9d3757ec ("an approval is paid as one reimbursement entry pointing to the disputed payment") and doc_wallet_protection_reimbursement_payment_3f70f708 (its own agent tool `post_protection_reimbursement_5be5cf5a`, "the payment is due once the claim is approved and its disputed payment carries no reimbursement yet").
- P2 has no further visible prerequisite sentence; its governing terms (protection window 180 days: 08-14 → 09-02 inside; one claim per payment: no earlier claim on 323d3ab5) hold.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - Sending an older reimbursement / the 09-20 400.00: no other reimbursement credit exists; "most recent claim reimbursement" becomes the 2722.76 credit once posted.
  - Coverage share 80 percent (counting the 2025-11-20 claim): outside the nine-month window for an account aged 475 days.
  - Coverage share counted per claim record (four records): the doc counts "claims the customer filed"; each claim has one filing.
  - Money back ignored or netted of seller fee: the 300.00 is a personal payment → "personal payments counting in full".
  - Delay credit flat 1 percent: 34 ≥ 30 days.
  - Ceiling 2500.00 binding: raised by the 1.5 multiplier for an active Gold membership.
  - Balance rate cut read on 1240.55 (0 cut): the balance is read "before the instant cash-out and its fee are taken off it" on the handling date, which, in the only admissible order, is after the reimbursement credit.
  - Fee inside the free quota: the 09-20 instant cash-out already uses the quota of 1.
  - Deposit tier at 1.50 (direct-deposit rate): measure 5200.00 and two deposits in the last month meet the top tier.
- "Do only what the customer asked" (hand over the instant cash-out now): excluded by the blocked-side sentence — without the reimbursement entry the instant cash-out of claim money "has no price" — and by the reimbursement payout document ("the payment is due once the claim is approved"). No route or other problem's tool name is needed for this exclusion.
